# A generated program builds when sngl's cache sits inside a repository git
# cannot read. The build directory is under the user cache, and what encloses
# that is whatever the user's home is -- a dotfiles checkout, often. `go build`
# stamps VCS information from the enclosing repository by default and failed
# with "error obtaining VCS status: exit status 128"; a generated program has no
# revision worth recording.

mkdir home/.git home/cache
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/home/cache
sngl build --lang go --platform bubbletea -o out app.sngl
exists out/app

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
